verses.ar: وَعَادَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلشَّرَّ فِي عَيْنَيِ ٱلرَّبِّ بَعْدَ مَوْتِ إِهُودَ،
verses.kjv: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, when Ehud was dead.
verses.web: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, when Ehud was dead.

verses.ar: فَبَاعَهُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ بِيَدِ يَابِينَ مَلِكِ كَنْعَانَ ٱلَّذِي مَلَكَ فِي حَاصُورَ. وَرَئِيسُ جَيْشِهِ سِيسَرَا، وَهُوَ سَاكِنٌ فِي حَرُوشَةِ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host [was] Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
verses.web: Yahweh sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

verses.ar: فَصَرَخَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ، لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ لَهُ تِسْعُ مِئَةِ مَرْكَبَةٍ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، وَهُوَ ضَايَقَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ بِشِدَّةٍ، عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً.
verses.kjv: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.
verses.web: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.

verses.ar: وَدَبُورَةُ ٱمْرَأَةٌ نَبِيَّةٌ زَوْجَةُ لَفِيدُوتَ، هِيَ قَاضِيَةُ إِسْرَائِيلَ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْوَقْتِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
verses.web: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.

verses.ar: وَهِيَ جَالِسَةٌ تَحْتَ نَخْلَةِ دَبُورَةَ بَيْنَ ٱلرَّامَةِ وَبَيْتِ إِيلَ فِي جَبَلِ أَفْرَايِمَ. وَكَانَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ يَصْعَدُونَ إِلَيْهَا لِلْقَضَاءِ.
verses.kjv: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
verses.web: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

verses.ar: فَأَرْسَلَتْ وَدَعَتْ بَارَاقَ بْنَ أَبِينُوعَمَ مِنْ قَادَشِ نَفْتَالِي، وَقَالَتْ لَهُ: «أَلَمْ يَأْمُرِ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُ إِسْرَائِيلَ: اِذْهَبْ وَٱزْحَفْ إِلَى جَبَلِ تَابُورَ، وَخُذْ مَعَكَ عَشْرَةَ آلَافِ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي نَفْتَالِي وَمِنْ بَنِي زَبُولُونَ،
verses.kjv: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, [saying], Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
verses.web: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

verses.ar: فَأَجْذُبَ إِلَيْكَ، إِلَى نَهْرِ قِيشُونَ سِيسَرَا رَئِيسَ جَيْشِ يَابِينَ بِمَرْكَبَاتِهِ وَجُمْهُورِهِ وَأَدْفَعَهُ لِيَدِكَ؟»
verses.kjv: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.
verses.web: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهَا بَارَاقُ: «إِنْ ذَهَبْتِ مَعِي أَذْهَبْ، وَإِنْ لَمْ تَذْهَبِي مَعِي فَلَا أَذْهَبُ».
verses.kjv: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, [then] I will not go.
verses.web: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَتْ: «إِنِّي أَذْهَبُ مَعَكَ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَا يَكُونُ لَكَ فَخْرٌ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ ٱلَّتِي أَنْتَ سَائِرٌ فِيهَا. لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ يَبِيعُ سِيسَرَا بِيَدِ ٱمْرَأَةٍ». فَقَامَتْ دَبُورَةُ وَذَهَبَتْ مَعَ بَارَاقَ إِلَى قَادَشَ.
verses.kjv: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.web: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for Yahweh will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

verses.ar: وَدَعَا بَارَاقُ زَبُولُونَ وَنَفْتَالِيَ إِلَى قَادَشَ، وَصَعِدَ وَمَعَهُ عَشَرَةُ آلَافِ رَجُلٍ. وَصَعِدَتْ دَبُورَةُ مَعَهُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
verses.web: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.

verses.ar: وَحَابِرُ ٱلْقَيْنِيُّ ٱنْفَرَدَ مِنْ قَايِنَ، مِنْ بَنِي حُوبَابَ حَمِي مُوسَى، وَخَيَّمَ حَتَّى إِلَى بَلُّوطَةٍ فِي صَعَنَايِمَ ٱلَّتِي عِنْدَ قَادَشَ.
verses.kjv: Now Heber the Kenite, [which was] of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which [is] by Kedesh.
verses.web: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

verses.ar: وَأَخْبَرُوا سِيسَرَا بِأَنَّهُ قَدْ صَعِدَ بَارَاقُ بْنُ أَبِينُوعَمَ إِلَى جَبَلِ تَابُورَ.
verses.kjv: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
verses.web: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

verses.ar: فَدَعَا سِيسَرَا جَمِيعَ مَرْكَبَاتِهِ، تِسْعَ مِئَةِ مَرْكَبَةٍ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، وَجَمِيعَ ٱلشَّعْبِ ٱلَّذِي مَعَهُ مِنْ حَرُوشَةِ ٱلْأُمَمِ إِلَى نَهْرِ قِيشُونَ.
verses.kjv: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, [even] nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that [were] with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.
verses.web: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.

verses.ar: فَقَالَتْ دَبُورَةُ لِبَارَاقَ: «قُمْ، لِأَنَّ هَذَا هُوَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِي دَفَعَ فِيهِ ٱلرَّبُّ سِيسَرَا لِيَدِكَ. أَلَمْ يَخْرُجِ ٱلرَّبُّ قُدَّامَكَ؟» فَنَزَلَ بَارَاقُ مِنْ جَبَلِ تَابُورَ وَوَرَاءَهُ عَشْرَةُ آلَافِ رَجُلٍ.
verses.kjv: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this [is] the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
verses.web: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which Yahweh has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t Yahweh gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

verses.ar: فَأَزْعَجَ ٱلرَّبُّ سِيسَرَا وَكُلَّ ٱلْمَرْكَبَاتِ وَكُلَّ ٱلْجَيْشِ بِحَدِّ ٱلسَّيْفِ أَمَامَ بَارَاقَ. فَنَزَلَ سِيسَرَا عَنِ ٱلْمَرْكَبَةِ وَهَرَبَ عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD discomfited Sisera, and all [his] chariots, and all [his] host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off [his] chariot, and fled away on his feet.
verses.web: Yahweh confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.

verses.ar: وَتَبِعَ بَارَاقُ ٱلْمَرْكَبَاتِ وَٱلْجَيْشَ إِلَى حَرُوشَةِ ٱلْأُمَمِ. وَسَقَطَ كُلُّ جَيْشِ سِيسَرَا بِحَدِّ ٱلسَّيْفِ. لَمْ يَبْقَ وَلَا وَاحِدٌ.
verses.kjv: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; [and] there was not a man left.
verses.web: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا سِيسَرَا فَهَرَبَ عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ إِلَى خَيْمَةِ يَاعِيلَ ٱمْرَأَةِ حَابِرَ ٱلْقَيْنِيِّ، لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ صُلْحٌ بَيْنَ يَابِينَ مَلِكِ حَاصُورَ وَبَيْتِ حَابِرَ ٱلْقَيْنِيِّ.
verses.kjv: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for [there was] peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.web: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

verses.ar: فَخَرَجَتْ يَاعِيلُ لِٱسْتِقْبَالِ سِيسَرَا وَقَالَتْ لَهُ: «مِلْ يَا سَيِّدِي، مِلْ إِلَيَّ. لَا تَخَفْ». فَمَالَ إِلَيْهَا إِلَى ٱلْخَيْمَةِ وَغَطَّتْهُ بِٱللِّحَافِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.
verses.web: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهَا: «ٱسْقِينِي قَلِيلَ مَاءٍ لِأَنِّي قَدْ عَطِشْتُ». فَفَتَحَتْ وَطَبَ ٱللَّبَنِ وَأَسْقَتْهُ ثُمَّ غَطَّتْهُ.
verses.kjv: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.
verses.web: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهَا: «قِفِي بِبَابِ ٱلْخَيْمَةِ، وَيَكُونُ إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدٌ وَسَأَلَكِ: أَهُنَا رَجُلٌ؟ أَنَّكِ تَقُولِينَ لَا».
verses.kjv: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.
verses.web: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَتْ يَاعِيلُ ٱمْرَأَةُ حَابِرَ وَتَدَ ٱلْخَيْمَةِ وَجَعَلَتِ ٱلْمِيتَدَةَ فِي يَدِهَا، وَقَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ وَضَرَبَتِ ٱلْوَتَدَ فِي صُدْغِهِ فَنَفَذَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَهُوَ مُتَثَقِّلٌ فِي ٱلنَّوْمِ وَمُتْعَبٌ، فَمَاتَ.
verses.kjv: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
verses.web: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا بِبَارَاقَ يُطَارِدُ سِيسَرَا، فَخَرَجَتْ يَاعِيلُ لِٱسْتِقْبَالِهِ وَقَالَتْ لَهُ: «تَعَالَ فَأُرِيَكَ ٱلرَّجُلَ ٱلَّذِي أَنْتَ طَالِبُهُ». فَجَاءَ إِلَيْهَا وَإِذَا سِيسَرَا سَاقِطٌ مَيْتًا وَٱلْوَتَدُ فِي صُدْغِهِ.
verses.kjv: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her [tent], behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail [was] in his temples.
verses.web: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.

verses.ar: فَأَذَلَّ ٱللهُ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ يَابِينَ مَلِكَ كَنْعَانَ أَمَامَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.
verses.web: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.

verses.ar: وَأَخَذَتْ يَدُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ تَتَزَايَدُ وَتَقْسُو عَلَى يَابِينَ مَلِكِ كَنْعَانَ حَتَّى قَرَضُوا يَابِينَ مَلِكَ كَنْعَانَ.
verses.kjv: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
verses.web: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
